kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
سللت (form I)
# سَلَلْتُ (salaltu) /sa.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of سَلَّ (salla)
# سَلَلْتَ (salalta) /sa.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of سَلَّ (salla)
# سَلَلْتِ (salalti) /sa.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of سَلَّ (salla)
# سُلِلْتُ (suliltu) /su.lil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
# سُلِ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
